question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of the Food Corporation of India (FCI)? (January 2025)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashutosh Agnihotri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Ashutosh Agnihotri, Additional Secretary in the Home Ministry, has been appointed as CMD of FCI.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **FCI is a statutory body under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food, and Public Distribution.**
 
• **Established in 1965 under the Food Corporation Act, 1964.**
 
• **FCI manages food procurement, storage, and distribution across India.**
 
• **Headquartered in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Food Corporation of India (FCI)__

 __
 
• Primary function: Ensure food security by managing procurement, storage, and distribution of food grains.
 
• Operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food, and Public Distribution.
 
 
 
• Key Roles of CMD__
 
 
• Oversees FCI's operations, policies, and strategic decisions.
 
• Ensures smooth functioning of food procurement and distribution systems.
